decisions_pending.question: Author income — withdrawable OUT vs in-app-spend-only?

decisions_resolved.decision: Gonka = 0% commission (BYO / pass-through) — the user pays Gonka directly, we don't tax it; matches the 'own provider = free' rule. We earn on the GRANT (paid in GNK), not on per-call Gonka margin. The GonkaGate platform fee only applies if we ever resell via our own key — deferred, not needed for the product.
